package.title: Tempo.Blazor.PdfViewer
package.description: PDF.js powered PDF viewer component for Tempo.Blazor with thumbnails, search, text layer, rotation, zoom, and continuous scroll.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.PdfViewer
gettingStarted.overview: PDF.js powered PDF viewer component for Tempo.Blazor with thumbnails, search, text layer, rotation, zoom, and continuous scroll.

items.description: Describes a text selection captured from the PDF text layer: the selected text, the one-based page it belongs to, and the normalized highlight rectangles covering it.

members.name: IsValid
members.description: Returns true when the selection has text and at least one valid rectangle.

members.name: ToAnchor
members.description: Builds a text range anchor from this selection.

items.description: View mode for the PDF viewer.
Extension methods for registering Tempo.Blazor PDF viewer services.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorPdfViewer
members.description: Registers services required by the PDF viewer component group.

items.description: Overlay that renders PDF annotation highlights and margin markers over the current page. Used internally by TmPdfViewer when annotations are enabled, reusing the shared document comment models.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id used for mention styling.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether marker interaction is disabled.

parameters.name: DraftAnchor
parameters.description: Current draft anchor for a pending, not-yet-saved annotation.

parameters.name: OnThreadSelected
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a thread marker or highlight is selected.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: One-based current page number.

parameters.name: SelectedThreadId
parameters.description: Selected thread id.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads should be rendered.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: Annotation threads available to render.

items.description: Side panel listing PDF annotation threads with per-thread comment detail, reply, resolve/reopen, delete, a resolved filter, and a composer for commenting on the current text selection. Used internally by TmPdfViewer when annotations are enabled.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id used for mention styling.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether panel interaction is disabled.

parameters.name: OnCreateThreadRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked with the body of a new thread requested from the pending selection.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when deleting a comment is requested.

parameters.name: OnReopenRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when reopening a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnReplyRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a reply is requested.

parameters.name: OnResolveRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when resolving a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnSelectionDismissed
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the pending selection is dismissed.

parameters.name: PendingSelection
parameters.description: Pending text selection awaiting a new comment, when present.

parameters.name: SelectedThreadId
parameters.description: Selected thread id.

parameters.name: SelectedThreadIdChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the selected thread id changes.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads are shown.

parameters.name: ShowResolvedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the resolved filter toggles.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: Annotation threads to render.

items.description: A reusable PDF viewer component powered by PDF.js v5. Supports page navigation, zoom, rotation, text layer, thumbnails, search, and continuous scroll.

parameters.name: AllowDownload
parameters.description: Whether to show the toolbar. Default is true.

parameters.name: AllowRotation
parameters.description: Whether to allow downloading the PDF. Default is true.

parameters.name: AnnotationProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to load and persist annotation threads when is true. When omitted, an in-memory provider keeps annotations for the current session.

parameters.name: Annotations
parameters.description: Optional seed threads used when no is supplied.

parameters.name: AnnotationsChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the loaded annotation set changes.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Callback when the view mode changes.

parameters.name: CurrentUser
parameters.description: Author applied to annotations created by the current viewer.

parameters.name: DocumentId
parameters.description: Stable document identifier used by the annotation provider. Falls back to .

parameters.name: EnableAnnotations
parameters.description: Whether the annotation layer and comments panel are enabled. Default is false.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: OnTextSelected
parameters.description: Callback invoked when text is selected in the viewer text layer.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: URL of the PDF document to display.

parameters.name: PageChanged
parameters.description: Current page number (1-based). Supports two-way binding.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Callback when the page changes.

parameters.name: ScaleChanged
parameters.description: Current zoom scale. Supports two-way binding.

parameters.name: ShowResolvedAnnotations
parameters.description: Whether resolved annotation threads are shown by default. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether to show a thumbnails sidebar. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowTextLayer
parameters.description: Whether to allow rotation. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowThumbnails
parameters.description: Whether to render a selectable text layer over the canvas. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: Callback when the scale changes.

parameters.name: ShowViewModeToggle
parameters.description: Whether to show a search input. Default is false.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: URL of the PDF document to display.

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: Whether to show a view mode toggle (single/continuous). Default is false.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Current view mode. Default is SinglePage.
